title: Propagating the LZ gain uncertainties: what g1 +- 2% and g2 +- 3% do to the recoil energy, the band position, delta_max and the fitted couplings
question: How is LZ's +-23 keV systematic on the 248 keV event shared between g1, g2, the NR yield model (Table S5 vs contour scale), W and the drift field, and how do the same nuisances move the 1.5 sigma band position, the efficiency at the event, delta_max(m), the P021 likelihood peak and the couplings d10 and kappa?
headline_result: g1 +-1.8% and g2 +-3.2% contribute only 3.7 and 0.8 keV to E_ML; with a +-4% NR light-yield scale the systematic is 9.6 keV (linear 9.5, MC 9.6), so the paper's +-23 keV requires a ~10% (10.4%) light-yield uncertainty at 250 keV; the band position carries +-0.54 sigma (g2 0.44 dominant; P(>2 sigma)=0.20, P(<1 sigma)=0.14); the acceptance at the reconstructed energy is scale-independent (0.951 +- 0.010); delta_max(1 TeV) = 386.6 +- 2.1 +- 2.1 keV; d10 = 0.279 +- 0.005; kappa(380) x/÷ 1.14 (g1), 1.30 (yield scale)
model_or_mechanism: P009 paper-contour yield scale Nq = s alpha_p E^beta_p with Ne from LZ-tuned NEST (Table S5 + p(E) break, nestpy); S1-only, combined-quanta and 2D Gaussian-likelihood energy estimators; linear propagation via uncertainties.wrap/error_components; 1e5-draw MC per source and combined; band sigma-distance anchored to P024 MC; eps = plateau x Phi((600 - g1 Nph)/sigma_S1c); delta_max via lz.delta_max_kev (June v_max 809 km/s); acceptance integrals over P012 L10 and P038 inelastic O1 spectra with an erf edge at E50
confidence: medium - gain sensitivities reproduce P009/P024/P038 to <=0.5 keV / 0.02 sigma, but the +-4% yield-scale prior, field bracket and plateau +-0.01 are assumptions
builds_on: LZ arXiv:2609.02823 (detector paragraph l.88, Results, Table S5); P009, P024, P038, P021, P012, P002, P007
agent_tools: Read x29, Bash x10, Write x5, Edit x15, Skill x1 (dataviz)
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1; uncertainties 3.2.3 (ufloat, wrap, error_components); nestpy 2.1.1 via lzcommon.nest_nr_yields; pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; common/lzcommon.py
local_inputs: fulltext.tex l.88, 165, 591-691; P009 results.json + script; P024 results.json; P038 P038_results.json + spectra_s_1000_full.npz; P012 P012_summary.json + P012_L10_spectra_d10_1.npz; P021 P021_peaks.csv; dossier; ledger; papers P002/P007/P009/P010/P012/P021/P024/P038; lzcommon.py; ENVIRONMENT_versions.txt
